event: 2025 ILCA U 21 Europeans and Open European Trophy
procedural_matters: The International Jury Panel was composed accoring to N1.4(b)
LAT 217898 was represented by Karlīna VAIVODE.
Race Committee was represented by Marko Misura (PRO).
LAT 217898 lodged scoring enquiry 21. october at 18:40. Same day LAT 217898 gets answer from the scorer as an emtpy form. LAT 217898 was waiting for the results to be corrected.
LAT 217898 coach next day in the morning at the coach meeting asked for the correction of the result. PRO answerd that the results will be corrected.
After the races on 22. october, the result was still not corrected. LAT 217898 lodged request for redress on that day at 17:31
facts: Before the hearing LAT 217898 was scored 47 in race 1.
In race 1 POL finsihed 42., CRO 211544 finished 43. LAT 217898 finished after CRO 211544
conclusions: LAT score in race 1 was made significantly worse through no fault of her own by an inproper action of the RC. Therefor requirements for redress in RRS 61.4(b)(1) were met.
decision: Redress is given to LAT 217898. LAT 217898 is to be scored on place 44 in race 1. Other boats score should be corrected accordingly.
